transcript: If you want an IIT Bombay certificate without doing JEE, this is your only chance. Dekho, you have watched 100 hours of tutorials, but tumhara resume abhi bhi blank hai. Aur companies ko proof of work chahiye, tumhara tutorial nahi. Aur koi bhi company tumhe aaj ke time hire hi nahi karegi agar tum unhe yeh bolte ho "Sir, mujhe AI aata hai aur mai yeh kaam kar sakta hu." They need proof of work. Aur agar tumhare paas proof of work nahi hai, then IIT Bombay fixes that. It is hosting Asia's largest tech fest and you can learn Machine Learning from scratch, data pre-processing, gradient boosting, and even deploying your own ML model. Aur sirf yahi nahi, you can also learn AI agents, Python, full stack web development, and a lot more. All of this and get an official IIT Bombay certificate. And jinko nahi pata unhe bata du that IIT Bombay is one of the most prestigious colleges of our country. Aur tumhare paas yaha ka official certificate ho sakta hai without being from science and tech background. So in my mind, it is a great opportunity. Aur agar tumhe yeh miss out nahi karna hai, then just comment me down below with "IIT" and I'll DM you the registration link personally myself.
caption: Comment me anything to register in IIT bombay right now !
